ambient_definitions: abbrev PrimitiveBasis (qubits : Nat) := Fin qubits → Fin 2
noncomputable def pairNorm (a b : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)

noncomputable def marginal {n : Nat} (f : PrimitiveBasis (n + 1) → ℝ) :
    PrimitiveBasis n → ℝ := fun b => pairNorm (f (Fin.snoc b 0)) (f (Fin.snoc b 1))
noncomputable def normSq {n : Nat} (f : PrimitiveBasis n → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ b, f b ^ 2

noncomputable def rotateRows {N M : ℕ} (A : _root_.Matrix (Fin N) (Fin M) ℝ)
    (i j : Fin N) (theta : ℝ) : _root_.Matrix (Fin N) (Fin M) ℝ :=
  fun row col =>
    if row = i then Real.cos (theta / 2) * A i col - Real.sin (theta / 2) * A j col
    else if row = j then Real.sin (theta / 2) * A i col + Real.cos (theta / 2) * A j col
    else A row col

formal_context.target: ∀ {N : ℕ} (A : _root_.Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ) (i j : Fin N), i ≠ j → ∀ theta : ℝ, (QuantumBlockEncoding.AdjacentGivens.rotateRows A i j theta).det = A.det

ambient_definitions: abbrev Core (l r : ℕ) := _root_.Matrix (Fin l) (Fin 2 × Fin r) ℝ

def complexCore {l r : ℕ} (A : Core l r) :
    _root_.Matrix (Fin 2 × Fin r) (Fin l) ℂ := fun out a => (A a out : ℂ)

formal_context.target: ∀ {l r : ℕ} (A : QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.Core l r), A * A.transpose = 1 → (QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.complexCore A).conjTranspose * QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.complexCore A = 1
